title: japan plans no crude oil release national reserve september october 2026 08 25
text:
TOKYO, Aug 25 (Reuters) - Japan plans no additional releases of crude oil from its national reserves ​in September or October, Economy, Trade ‌and Industry Minister Ryosei Akazawa said on Tuesday.
Crude oil procurement in September is expected to fall to ​about 80% of last year's average ​monthly volume from 100% in August, as ⁠tankers that would normally transit the ​Bab el-Mandeb Strait are being rerouted via the ​longer Suez route, he said.
